data.description:
## Task

Create a RED regression test that verifies all three sc-coverage prompt files contain explicit scoping instructions that exclude ## Closure Checks items from coverage counts.

## Testing Mode

RED — this test must FAIL before T1 (94f7-b7ef-99c4-421d) is applied, and PASS after.

## Test File to Create

tests/skills/test-sprint-sc-coverage-closure-checks-scoping.sh

## Test Requirements (DD4)

The test must verify:
1. Each of the 3 sc-coverage prompt files (haiku/sonnet/opus) contains the text "Closure Checks"
2. Each file contains scoping language that references "Success Criteria" in the same context
3. The test confirms that items from ## Closure Checks are excluded (scoping instruction present)

The test should follow the same TAP-like pattern as tests/skills/test-sprint-sc-coverage-prompts.sh:
- ok()/fail() helpers
- PASS/FAIL counters
- Exit non-zero if any FAIL

## Behavioral Regression Scenario (DD4)

A story ticket body with both:
- `## Success Criteria` containing 3 items
- `## Closure Checks` containing 2 items

Should produce a coverage count of 3 (only SC items), not 5. The test verifies the prompt files
contain the scoping instruction that prevents Closure Checks items from being included.

## Implementation Notes

- Set executable bit: chmod +x tests/skills/test-sprint-sc-coverage-closure-checks-scoping.sh
- Use REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
- Check each tier file separately with clear pass/fail messages
- Test must be runnable standalone: bash tests/skills/test-sprint-sc-coverage-closure-checks-scoping.sh

## Done Definitions Satisfied

DD4
data.title: RED test: sc-coverage prompts contain Closure Checks scoping instruction
